scope: training-only tick input diagnostics; not calibration protocol v2
base: audited 30-365 day candidates with same-date carry, no extrapolation, SpecialSettlement=0
primary: both positive valid recorded times equal to the daily anchor
anchor: most frequent identical bid/ask timestamp among base rows on that date; ties choose latest; chosen without IV or price errors
sensitivity_rule: both bid and ask within threshold of fixed daily anchor AND their mutual gap within threshold
iv_reconstruction: BSM(UnderlyingLast, Strike/1000, Days/365, r, q, vendor IV) versus Last
select_dates: two chronological quantiles floor((n-1)/3) and floor(2*(n-1)/3) in each year/rate-regime stratum of carry-covered dates
